Lena (Product): @channel quick heads-up: tomorrow 08:45 PT we GA the new asynchronous generation endpoint `POST /v1/async-gen` for hosted customers. Its designed for long-running or high-throughput jobs (batch prompts, long-context summaries, async tool pipelines) and includes a priority-routing option for latency-sensitive keys. Non-breaking opt-in. See rollout notes below.

Vik (Eng): How do clients use it? sample payload?

Lena (Product): Clients POST a job and poll or webhook for completion. New fields: `priority: low|normal|high` and `max_wait_ms`. Example curl: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/async-gen \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"mosaicx-batch","inputs":["long doc ..."],"priority":"high","max_wait_ms":120000, "callback_url":"https://hooks.example/app"}'
```
Sofia (ML): Model note: mosaicx-batch uses chunked attention optimizations and async KV flushes. In our evals it preserves end-to-end coherence on long documents; latency for high-priority jobs is ~40% better vs normal routing for short batches. We'll keep eval hooks watching for hallucination drift on cross-chunk summaries.

Carlos (SRE): Ops notes: Canary plan = us-west-2 -> us-east-1 -> eu-west-1, 30m windows. Abort if job failure rate >1.5x baseline or queue backlog grows >20% for 10m. Priority routing maps high keys to reserved fast lanes; fallback routes to standard `/v1/generate` for interactive traffic. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/async-gen-ga (pinned).

Janet (Docs): Docs PR ready: https://git.redwood/docs/pulls/4811  includes quickstart, webhook examples, SDK helpers (node/python/go), and a migration note for customers moving from ad-hoc polling. Will publish at deploy.

Vik (Eng): Any auth/quota differences? priority abuse risk?

Lena (Product): Auth same keys. Quotas: priority lanes consume a small priority token (separate counters) to prevent abuse; enterprise can request higher priority capacity. Abuse detection: if a key hits >60% high-priority usage sustained, we auto-throttle and open a support ticket. Trust signals and rate limits are in the migration doc.

Sofia (ML): Metrics to watch: cross-chunk coherence, tool-call alignment (for async tool pipelines), and completion latency by priority. We'll enable eval hooks and surface regressions to Optimize.

Carlos (SRE): DeployBot: scheduled job ag-197900. Canary start 2026-03-29T15:45:00Z. Logs will be posted here.

DeployBot: Canary started (job ag-197900)  logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/ag-197900/logs

Carlos (SRE): Canary +7m: job acceptance rate nominal, high-priority lane p50 220ms to start processing, errors flat. Proceeding to next region.

Vik (Eng): Added Console panels: async job queue depth, per-key priority usage, webhook delivery success.

Janet (Docs): Published migration and webhook troubleshooting: /docs/async-gen. Included guidance for retry/backoff and idempotency keys.

DeployBot: Canary complete: success. Beginning regional rollout.

Carlos (SRE): Regional rollout complete for initial regions. No aborts. Monitoring window open for 1h for backlog signals.

Lena (Product): Thanks team  we'll post a GA recap with initial usage and cost impact in 48h. If you see priority misuse or webhook failures, tag @Carlos.

Sofia (ML): I'll surface any evaluation anomalies into this thread.

Vik (Eng): :rocket:
